title: ConnectionsHostModeResult
description: Result of the connections.hostMode JSON-RPC method: the method the named connection's host uses. The single declaration of this shape: the renderer's TypeScript type is generated from it and the Go transport is validated against it.

profileId.description: The connection that was asked about, echoed so the renderer keys the answer on the connection the backend resolved rather than its own copy of the request.

mode.description: The host's integration method. auto means no answer is recorded for this host's key yet — the connect-time ask will decide (ADR-0033) — and it is also every answer for a destination known_hosts has no key for.
